correctness.rationale: PASS: The DFE solves -d Delta S=Lambda, so S=Psi/d; inserting in the source Rayleigh quotient indeed produces C/(d^2 A+d B). A>0 for nonzero H_0^1 tests, B,C>0. Each quotient is >1 iff d is smaller than the positive quadratic root r_phi. For d>sup r_phi, pointwise C<=d_c^2 A+d_c B <= (d_c/d)(d^2 A+d B), so the supremum is strictly <1. At d=d_c, maximizing roots r_phi_j ->d_c give a lower bound (r_phi_j/d_c)^2 ->1, so equality holds without assuming attainment. Poincare and bounded coefficients give a finite positive d_c and the min-gamma/eigenvalue bound. Denominators increase at least by d2/d1, giving monotonicity. Global attractivity is inherited exactly from the primary source equal-diffusion theorem, not strengthened. Four rational A,B,C triples were rechecked with exact rational root brackets; those tests only corroborate algebra.
